scan_linter_check.description:
Flags writes in a Business Rule that can trigger the same rule again, using the rule's table, When value and actions: - an async rule that runs on update and calls current.update() without current.setWorkflow(false) first - update() or updateMultiple() (rule runs on update), or insert() (rule runs on insert), on a GlideRecord of the rule's table or a table that extends it, without setWorkflow(false) on that GlideRecord first
This is a potential problem: the check cannot evaluate the rule's conditions, so a rule whose conditions never match its own writes is still reported. Before, after and display rules calling current.update() are reported by SN-BR-001 instead.
scan_linter_check.name: SN-BR-002: Potential recursive Business Rule update
scan_linter_check.resolution_details: Call setWorkflow(false) on the record before saving it when other Business Rules must not run, or add a condition that stops the rule from matching its own write. If the rule's conditions already prevent recursion, mute the finding with a reason.
scan_linter_check.short_description: A Business Rule writes records that can trigger the same rule again.
scan_linter_check.sys_name: SN-BR-002: Potential recursive Business Rule update
